Planning estimate · not saved to HAC

Assignment mode adds one new score to imported category point totals, applies its multiplier, and combines categories by their active weights. Dropped scores, teacher overrides, replacement rules, rounding, and extra-credit policies may produce a different official result. A blank or code is never treated as zero.

BUILD A CREDIT-WEIGHTED ESTIMATE

Your GPA, explored.

Planning scale, not an official Irving ISD GPA. HAC imports a current marking-period view, not your transcript. Set eligible courses, credits, and grade-point bonuses yourself. Exclusions, repeated courses, cohort rules, and final semester grades can change an official GPA.
Adjust the generic 4.0 planning scale

Defaults: A ≥90 → 4, B ≥80 → 3, C ≥70 → 2, D ≥60 → 1, below D → 0. No rounding is applied before conversion. Edit this scale to match your planning needs; this is not the district’s verified GPA table.

CURRENT UNWEIGHTED—Credit-weighted · selected scale
CURRENT WITH BONUSES—Your per-course bonus settings
PROJECTED UNWEIGHTED—Using what-if grades
PROJECTED WITH BONUSES—Using what-if grades + bonuses
IncludeCourseCurrent %What-if %CreditsBonus pointsRemove

Formula: sum of (grade points × course credits) ÷ included credits. Blank what-if grades use current grades. Bonus points are entered manually; they are not inferred from course names. This plan exists only in this page and resets when a new HAC snapshot arrives. District grading procedures ↗

Your connection.

One website, your school data.

Xpress signs in to official HAC on the server and reads the academic tables. No addon or browser extension is required. Use Refresh to read changes.

Temporary records.

Your password is forwarded once and is not saved. The HAC session and imported academic tables stay in server memory for up to one hour, with a 15-minute inactivity timeout. Signing out clears them.

Official records.

Grades are copied from HAC. GPA and what-if results are planning estimates. Contact your campus for official corrections or certified transcripts.

Current view.

This version imports the account’s default student and reporting view. To switch students or periods, use official HAC. If the login requires extra verification or the table layout changes, Xpress reports the issue instead of guessing.
